HSTU’s relative attention bias incorporates positional and temporal information; removing both does not isolate positional bias. Its pointwise attention also makes context cardinality relevant. ([HSTU paper](https://arxiv.org/html/2402.17152v3)) Recommended factorial protocol: cross {no blocking, recent blocking, older blocking} with {position bias present, removed}, holding temporal bias fixed. Report every cell, conditional blocking effects, and the interaction contrast (HR_recent,on−HR_older,on)−(HR_recent,off−HR_older,off). Factorial guidance supports testing interactions before attributing independent component contributions. ([NIST](https://www.itl.nist.gov/div898/handbook/pri/section6/pri615.htm)) Distinguish inference interventions on one checkpoint from retrained architectural ablations; they answer different questions.

For matched blocking, remove equal numbers of valid context keys per user/query; specify layer/head coverage, causal eligibility, self-attention and short-history handling. Preserve original positions and timestamps rather than compacting sequences. Report blocked/retained counts and positional-distance distributions: equal cardinality does not equal matched distance, and recent-versus-older blocking deliberately changes distance. Include distance-stratified or random-block controls before claiming effects beyond recency. For HSTU, zero prohibited attention contributions after SiLU; do not assume softmax-style masking or introduce count-dependent rescaling.

Keep the pinned 200 users/category, identical 99 unique negatives/user, seed 42 and evaluator unchanged; document negative distribution, exclusions and candidate ordering. Sampled HR@10 can reverse full-catalog model rankings. ([Krichene–Rendle](https://research.google/pubs/on-sampled-metrics-for-item-recommendation/)) Disclose evaluator tie handling and cutoff-tie frequency; candidate order must not silently favor positives. ([McSherry–Najork](https://marc.najork.org/papers/ecir2008.pdf)) Bootstrap users within category with identical resampled indices across all cells; recompute equally weighted four-category means, paired differences and interactions. Report 95% intervals, resample count/method/seed; these condition on checkpoints and sampled candidates, excluding training-seed and candidate-sampling uncertainty. ([Paired bootstrap](https://docs.scipy.org/doc/scipy/reference/generated/scipy.stats.bootstrap.html))
